report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency, but current gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.0012, p95 75ms, INFO 200 logs, zero dependency timeouts and pool waiters. Only one ERROR trace shows a 949ms gateway->inventory call. This single span cannot establish a bounded root cause, and healthy metrics contradict the alert premise. Handing off for downstream telemetry.
missing_evidence: Gateway metrics show error_rate 0.0012 and p95 75ms, contradicting the alert; need alert-window metrics confirming elevated error rate/latency.
Need order and inventory service traces/metrics to localize the 949ms ERROR span on gateway->inventory.
Need inventory->redis latency/timeout telemetry to assess redis-timeout.
Need order->postgresql pool metrics to assess db-pool-exhaustion.
Need gateway logs at ERROR level; only INFO 200 request_complete observed.
